description_en: Sets a specific user as an administrator in a room by calling the SetUserAdmin operation
description_zh: 调用SetUserAdmin接口，设置房间内某特定用户为管理员
kebab_example: aliyun imp set-user-admin --app-id 7m000q --room-id AE350000T95F --user-id er0000h --region cn-hangzhou
name: SetUserAdmin
